answer: Farming becomes a fable bet on surviving 40 epochs of grading, and every shale settlement recomputes the ledge schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 40 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 9 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 36 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
